REPORT_ENGINE: Kitten hiding in a car engine
REPORT_CONSTRUCTION: Injured cat on a building site

ADOPT_GRANDMA_DESC: Lives alone in a flat. Looking for a calm companion for the sofa.
ADOPT_FAMILY_KIDS_DESC: A house with a garden and two kids who can’t wait. They want a playful kitten.
ADOPT_FARMER_DESC: Has a dog and hens on the farm. Looking for an independent cat that doesn’t scare easily.
ADOPT_STUDENT_DESC: Small flat, lots of lectures. Needs a cat that doesn’t mind some time alone.
ADOPT_HOMEWORKER_DESC: Works from home in a quiet flat, no kids. Would love a cat on his lap.
ADOPT_YOUNG_COUPLE_DESC: Their first flat together and busy lives. Dreaming of a kitten.
ADOPT_RETIRED_VET_DESC: Spent her life caring for animals. Has a garden and is happy to take an older cat.
ADOPT_DOG_OWNER_DESC: A house with a garden and a big friendly dog. Looking for a brave cat.
UI_NO_REPORTS: No reports yet. A new one will come soon.
UI_NO_CAGE: No free cage. Heal a cat, then rehome or keep it.
UI_READY_HINT: Healthy and trusting. Wait for an adopter, or keep her.
UI_RESIDENT_HINT: Lives in the corner and attracts visitors who leave donations.
UI_MATCH_UNCERTAIN: estimate only – you don’t know her whole personality
UI_POOR_WARNING: I’m not sure they’re a good fit…
POSTCARD_PERFECT: {cat} is perfectly happy with us. Thank you for bringing us together!
POSTCARD_GOOD: {cat} has settled in and slept in the bed for the first time today. Thank you!
UI_NO_POSTCARDS: Postcards arrive a few minutes after an adoption.
UI_WELCOME_NOTHING: The cats were waiting for you.
MG_TICK_HINT: Grab a tick and pull it away slowly. Too fast and it slips!
MG_FEATHER_HINT: Wiggle the feather – not too fast, not too slow.
MG_HOLD_HINT: Hold your finger on the cat until the ring fills.
MG_QUIET_HINT: Don’t do anything. Just be there.
UI_TRAITS_HINT: You learn her personality through care – by what she enjoys and what she doesn’t.
CH_SHY: Find a home for a shy cat
TUT_REPORT: Hi, I’m Zuzka! A cat report came in – tap 📋 and take the cat in.
TUT_EXAMINE: First a check-up: in the Health tab use ✋ and 🌡️ to find out what’s wrong.
TUT_TREAT: Now treat everything we found – tap Treat.
TUT_CARE: She’s healthier but doesn’t trust us yet. Win her trust in the Care tab.
TUT_READY: She’s ready! Wait for a visitor 🚪, or keep her as a resident.
TUT_MENU: Great job! The ☰ menu has challenges, the album and the equipment shop.
UI_CHALLENGES_HINT: Challenges have no time limit. A new one comes after you claim the reward.
UI_ALBUM_HINT: Every cat you rehome or keep is recorded by breed and coat.
UI_NEW_GAME_CONFIRM: Really start over? Your saved game will be deleted.
TOAST_CHALLENGE: Challenge complete! Claim the reward in ☰
MG_BANDAGE_HINT: Circle your finger around the paw – wrap it three times. Stay close to the bandage.
MG_EAR_HINT: Wipe all the dirt from the ears with your finger.
MG_SYRUP_HINT: Tap when the marker is in the green zone. Three spoonfuls.
MG_BREATH_HINT: Hold your finger while the circle grows (breathe in). Let go while it shrinks (breathe out).
UI_CAFE_DESC: Resident cats move into the café: +{slots} spots, guests who leave donations and double passive donations.
UI_CAFE_NO_RESIDENTS: Guests come once at least one resident cat lives here. Keep a recovered cat as a resident.
UI_CAFE_NO_GUESTS: No guests yet – someone will drop by soon. Tap the bubble above a guest or Serve.
TOAST_CAFE_OPEN: The café is open! Resident cats moved in ☕
TOAST_GUEST: A guest came to the café ☕
MG_BATH_HINT_FOAM: Rub the cat with your finger until it's covered in foam.
MG_BATH_HINT_RINSE: Now rinse the foam off – keep rubbing until it's gone. The fleas will flee!
MG_CLAWS_HINT: Tap when the line is on the white tip of the claw. The pink part hurts!
UNLOCK_ADOPTERS_PLUS: one more visitor at a time
UI_MAX_LEVEL: Top level – you are the National Feline Centre! ❤
UI_CAFE_CLOSED: 🌙 The café is closed at night – the cats are asleep. We open at 6:00.
TOAST_CAFE_NIGHT: 🌙 The café has closed, the cats are going to sleep
TOAST_CAFE_MORNING: ☀️ Good morning! The café is open
REPORT_FAMILY: A cat family in a garden shed – mum with kittens
MG_VACCINE_HINT: Stroke the cat's head until it calms down. Then tap the green spot on its neck.
MG_DROPS_HINT: Tap when the dropper is above the ear. Three drops.
UI_SHELTER_DESC: A new building: quarantine (+{cages} cages), a clinic with otoscope and vaccinations, cat families.
UI_QUARANTINE_LINE: Quarantine: {free} of {total} free · Garage: {g} of {gt} free
UI_SHELTER_EMPTY: Quarantine is empty. When the garage is full, new cats come here – or move a patient with the button on its card.
STAFF_CARETAKER_DESC: Feeds hungry cats and brushes dirty ones.
STAFF_VET_DESC: Gives new cats their first check-up and finds conditions. You do the treating.
STAFF_BARISTA_DESC: Serves café guests who have been waiting a while (a bit smaller donation than yours).
STAFF_SOCIAL_DESC: Brings more adopters, and better matches for your cats.
UI_STAFF_HINT: Staff handle routine for you – you can still do everything yourself.
UI_GARAGE_EMPTY: No patients in the garage. New cats come from reports.
REPORT_REFERRAL: 💗 Case from another shelter – needs the clinic
UI_CLINIC_DESC: A fourth building: laboratory, X-ray and operating room. Harder cases from other shelters, neutering before adoption.
CLINIC_LAB_DESC: A blood test reveals diabetes, kidney disease and urinary infections.
CLINIC_XRAY_DESC: X-rays reveal fractures (splint) and swallowed objects.
CLINIC_OR_DESC: Surgery for swallowed objects and neutering before adoption (+★, better match).
TOAST_CLINIC_OPEN: The clinic is built! ⚕️ Buy its rooms in the shop.
UI_NEUTER_HINT: A neutered cat brings more ★ on adoption and matches adopters better.
UI_CLINIC_CASE: Case from another shelter – more ★ and a bigger fee after adoption.
UI_CLINIC_EMPTY: Nobody is waiting here right now. Cats the clinic can help will show up here.
UI_CLINIC_TAP: Tap a machine – microscope, X-ray or operating table – and pick a patient.
MG_XRAY_HINT_FRAME: Hold the frame over the cat until the bar fills.
MG_XRAY_HINT_FIND: Tap the spot on the X-ray where the problem is.
MG_SURG_SLEEP: Hold your finger down to keep the needle in the green.
MG_SURG_EXTRACT: Slowly pull the object out of the wound with tweezers.
MG_SURG_STITCH: Stitch the wound – tap the dots from left to right.
MG_SPLINT_HINT: Circle your finger around the paw to wrap it. Slowly – not too tight!
UI_CATIO_DESC: An outdoor run by the café: residents go out during the day and their satisfaction drops half as fast.
TOAST_CATIO_OPEN: The catio is ready! 🌳 Residents can go outside.
UI_CATIO_NIGHT: It's night – the residents are sleeping inside the café.
UI_CATIO_INSIDE: All residents are inside right now. Someone will run out soon.
UI_CATIO_NONE: Nobody here yet – keep a healed cat as a resident.
UI_CATIO_HINT: Residents go in and out on their own. Outside they get bored more slowly, so they bring more donations.
UI_HOTEL_DESC: Owners leave their cat with you for a while. Care for it – a happy guest pays more and brings ★. {n} suites to start.
TOAST_HOTEL_OPEN: The cat hotel is open! 🏨 The first guests are on their way.
TOAST_HOTEL_OUT: The owner picked up {cat} and paid {fee} €
TOAST_HOTEL_OUT_STAR: {cat} had a wonderful stay! The owner paid {fee} € and +★
UI_HOTEL_STAY_LINE: The owner comes in {min} min. Right now they would pay {fee} €.
UI_HOTEL_HINT: Feed, brush and play with the guests. At {at} % happiness or more the owner adds ★.
UI_HOTEL_EMPTY: The hotel is waiting for guests – they come during the day when a suite is free.
UI_HOTEL_NIGHT: It's night – new guests arrive in the morning.
UI_FLOOR2_DESC: A new floor for the CT and the rehab pool.
TOAST_FLOOR_OPEN: The clinic has a 2nd floor! 🏢 Buy the CT and the pool.
CLINIC_CT_DESC: The CT reveals heart disease and spine problems.
CLINIC_POOL_DESC: Swimming treats the spine, and rehab after a fracture or surgery helps (+health, bigger fee).
UI_REHAB_HINT: A swim after a fracture or surgery: +health and a bigger adoption fee.
UI_CLINIC2_TAP: Tap the CT or the pool and pick a patient.
MG_CT_HINT: Hold your finger – the ring scans. When the cat wiggles (!), let go!
MG_SWIM_HINT: Tap left and right paw in turn.
UI_EDUCATION_DESC: A classroom for school trips. Teach the kids about cats (quiz) – it brings ★, donations and an adopter sooner.
TOAST_EDUCATION_OPEN: The education centre is open! 🎓 The first trip is coming soon.
TOAST_TRIP: A school trip arrived ({n} kids) 🎒 They are waiting for a talk in the education centre.
TOAST_LECTURE_DONE: The kids loved it! {money} € donation, +{rep} ★ and they'll talk about adoption at home.
TOAST_TRIP_LEFT: The trip left without a talk – they left {money} €.
UI_TRIP_LINE: Trip: {n} kids with their teacher. They'll wait {min} more min.
UI_LECTURE_HINT: A cat quiz: a better result means more ★. {money} € donation, then the kids play with the residents.
UI_TRIP_NONE: Nobody here right now. School trips come during the day.
UI_TRIP_NIGHT: No trips in the evening or at night.
UI_NO_TRIP: No school trip is waiting right now.
QUIZ_1_Q: How often should a cat get fresh water?
QUIZ_2_Q: What does it usually mean when a cat purrs?
QUIZ_3_A1: Better not – it can upset their tummy
QUIZ_4_A1: To sharpen claws and mark territory
QUIZ_5_Q: What should you do if you find an abandoned kitten?
QUIZ_5_A1: Call a shelter or a vet
QUIZ_6_Q: How should you approach a shy cat?
QUIZ_6_A1: Slowly, and let it come to me
QUIZ_7_Q: Why is it good to neuter cats?
QUIZ_8_Q: Which food is poisonous for cats?
QUIZ_9_Q: How many hours a day do cats sleep?
ACHD_SOCIAL: Play or cuddle with a cat {n}×
ACHD_ADOPTED_1: Find a home for your first cat
REPORT_MILL: 🏚️ Kitten mill rescue – mother with kittens
EVENT_WINTER_DESC: It's freezing and people find more cold cats. Reports come 2× as often and some cats are hypothermic – warm them up in a blanket.
EVENT_OPENDAY_DESC: The shelter is open to the public! More guests visit the café and adopters come much more often.
EVENT_MILL_DESC: The police shut down a kitten mill. A mother with a big litter is coming – the neighbours lent 4 temporary quarantine cages.
UI_EVENT_GOAL: Goal: {goal} (within {min} min) – a bonus if you make it.
UI_EVENT_REWARD: Reward: {money} € and {rep} ★, plus {bm} € and {br} ★ for the goal. Events never fail.
TOAST_EVENT_OFFER: New event: {name} – tap it at the top
UI_HEARTS_HINT: You earn hearts for postcards, new album slots, rare cats, achievements and completed events.
UI_RARE_HINT: rare cat: bigger adoption fee, ★ and an album page
UI_PAUSE_HINT: Game time stands still while the menu is open.
UI_EXIT_CONFIRM: Quit the game? Your progress is saved.
POSTCARD_PERFECT_2: {cat} claimed my armchair on day one and hasn't let go since. It's love!
POSTCARD_PERFECT_3: Every morning we wake up to purring. We can't imagine home without {cat} anymore.
POSTCARD_PERFECT_4: {cat} made friends with the whole family and the neighbours too. Here's a photo from the balcony!
POSTCARD_GOOD_2: {cat} still hides under the sofa sometimes, but now comes over for pets unasked.
POSTCARD_GOOD_3: The first days were careful, but {cat} has found the windowsill and watches the birds.
POSTCARD_GOOD_4: {cat} finished a whole bowl today and then fell asleep in the sun. We're so glad!
UI_PC_PINS_FULL: The pinboard is full – unpin one first.
UI_PC_KEEP_HINT: The latest {n} postcards are kept; pinned ones stay forever.
MG_HAND_HINT: Gently run your finger over the head, body and both paws.
MG_THERMO_HINT_SHAKE: First shake the thermometer down – drag it up and down.
MG_THERMO_HINT_PLACE: Now place it on the cat, in the green ring.
MG_THERMO_HINT_WAIT: Wait a moment for the beep…
MG_STETH_HINT: Place the stethoscope on each ring and hold it – the heart and both lungs.
MG_OTO_HINT: Shine the otoscope into the ear and look all around.
MG_BRUSH_HINT: Brush with the fur – drag the comb across the cat from left to right.
MG_TREAT_HINT: Slowly bring the fish to the cat's mouth – quick moves scare the cat.
MG_WARM_HINT: Rub the cat in gentle circles until it's warm again.
UI_LIKES_HINT: Try activities in the Care tab – the cat's reaction will be noted here.
SAY_VET_BUSY: Patients waiting for an exam or treatment: {n}. On it!
SAY_VET_IDLE: Everyone is examined and treated. We can take in more.
SAY_CARE_BUSY: Hungry or sad cats: {n}. I'm on my way.
SAY_CARE_IDLE: Everyone is fed and content. Nice work!
SAY_SOCIAL_ADOPTERS: Adopters are here: {n}. Take a look (🚪).
SAY_SOCIAL_READY: Ready for adoption: {n}. I'm posting about them online!
SAY_SOCIAL_IDLE: Nobody is ready for adoption yet. Treatment and trust first.
SAY_BARISTA_BUSY: Guests waiting for their order: {n}. Tap the bubble above them!
SAY_BARISTA_RATING: Guests rate us ★ {r}. Happy residents and a cozy café help.
SAY_BARISTA_IDLE: Quiet for now. Guests come to see the residents.
SAY_HOTEL: Hotel guests: {n} of {max} suites. Don't forget to feed them.
SAY_HOTEL_EMPTY: The hotel is empty for now – guests arrive during the day.
SAY_ZUZKA_CHALLENGE: A reward is waiting on the challenge board! (☰ → Challenges)
SAY_ZUZKA_REPORTS: New reports: {n}. A cat somewhere needs help (📋).
SAY_ZUZKA_TREAT: Cats that still need an exam or treatment: {n}.
SAY_ZUZKA_ADOPT: Adopters are here and someone is ready. Shall we find a home? (🚪)
SAY_ZUZKA_IDLE_1: Lovely day! The cats look content.
SAY_ZUZKA_IDLE_2: Did you know shy cats love it when you just sit quietly with them?
SAY_ZUZKA_IDLE_3: A cat that trusts you finds a home much more easily.
SAY_ZUZKA_IDLE_4: A cozier garage means cats trust you faster. See Shop → 🪴 Decorations.
UI_RATING_GOOD: Excellent rating – guests come {p} % more often.
UI_RATING_BAD: Poor rating – guests come {p} % less often. Serve them and care for the residents.
REVIEW_NOT_SERVED: Great cats, but I never got my coffee…
REVIEW_CAT_SAD: {cat} looked sad. I hope someone cheers them up.
REVIEW_PERFECT: Perfect afternoon! {cat} purred next to my coffee. I'll be back!
REVIEW_CAT_HAPPY: {cat} is a sweetheart, napped next to me the whole time.
REVIEW_PLAIN: Lovely cats, but the place could be cozier.
REVIEW_COZY: Cozy place and good coffee. Recommended!
UI_CITY_INTRO: Neutering campaigns: trap stray cats, neuter them and return them. Fewer unwanted kittens on the street – and a better name for your shelter.
UI_CITY_REWARD: Reward: +{rep} ★ and +{h} ❤ (+{dh} ❤ more for a cleared district). Takes about {min} min, each one costs more.
UI_CITY_BONUS: Districts cleared: {n} · adopters come {p} % more often.
TOAST_CAMPAIGN_START: Campaign started – the team heads out ✂️
TOAST_DISTRICT_CLEARED: {name} is cleared! People say thank you 💌
UI_ADAY_HINT: Hold an Adoption Day: lots of adopters come at once for {min} min (someone must be ready).
TOAST_ADAY_ON: 🎉 Adoption Day! Adopters are pouring in.
TOAST_ADAY_OFF: Adoption Day is over. Thank you!
UI_WISH_SHOP_HINT: You can also spend hearts on your residents' wishes – see a resident's Care tab.
WISH_BOX: a cardboard box to hide in
WISH_BLANKET: a blanket warm from the dryer
WISH_WINDOW: a window perch for bird watching
UI_PRESTIGE_DESC: Levels completed: {n}. You can restart the programme from the town – campaigns get cheap again and you earn {n} 🏅: adoption fees +{fee} % and campaign rewards +{rew} % for good. The adopter bonus from cleared districts stays.
UI_DECOR_ROOM_LOCKED: You haven't built “{room}” yet – you can furnish it once it's built (Shop → Build).
UI_WALLS_BUY_HINT: Wall colours are bought with ❤ in the Hearts tab.
UI_WALLS_APPLY_HINT: Apply a bought colour in Decorations, under the garage or the café.
